q: The old painting was carefully _____ to its original beauty by experts.
explain: restore v. 恢复，修复。
translation: 专家们精心修复了这幅旧画，使其恢复了原有的美感。

q: A walk in the fresh air can have a _____ effect on a tired mind.
explain: restorative adj. 有助于恢复健康的，滋补的。
translation: 在新鲜空气中散步对疲惫的心灵有恢复元气的效果。

q: The palace is closed for _____, so tourists cannot visit it this month.
explain: restoration n. 修复，恢复。
translation: 宫殿因修复而关闭，所以游客这个月无法参观。

q: This job requires highly _____ skills that only a few people have.
explain: specialized adj. 专门的，专业的。
translation: 这份工作需要只有少数人才具备的高度专业技能。

q: The _____ temperature in this city during May is about twenty degrees.
explain: average adj. 平均的；普通的。
translation: 这座城市五月份的平均温度大约是二十度。

q: Parents in this area spend an _____ of two hundred dollars a year on toys.
explain: average n. 平均数，平均水平（an average of 平均为）。
translation: 这个地区的父母每年平均花两百美元买玩具。

q: She decided to _____ a career in medicine after graduating from college.
explain: pursue v. 追求，从事。
translation: 大学毕业后，她决定从事医学事业。

q: The game was _____ off because of the heavy rain and strong wind.
explain: call v. 打电话，称呼（call off 取消）。
translation: 由于大雨和强风，比赛被取消了。

q: It is not _____ to finish this project within such a short time.
explain: feasible adj. 可行的。
translation: 在这么短的时间内完成这个项目是不可行的。

q: The manager _____ his plan to improve the company's performance.
explain: outline v. 概述，概括。
translation: 经理概述了他提高公司业绩的计划。

q: She gave a brief _____ of the main events in the story.
explain: outline n. 概要，大纲。
translation: 她简要概述了故事中的主要事件。

q: It is important to _____ a healthy balance between work and rest.
explain: maintain v. 保持，维持。
translation: 保持工作和休息之间的健康平衡很重要。

q: She remembered every last _____ of what her friend had told her.
explain: detail n. 细节，详情。
translation: 她记得朋友告诉她的每一个细节。

q: The report _____ all the problems that the company is facing.
explain: detail v. 详述，详细说明。
translation: 报告详细说明了公司面临的所有问题。

q: He made a _____ visit to the city to attend two important meetings.
explain: brief adj. 短暂的；简洁的。
translation: 他短暂访问了这座城市，参加了两场重要会议。

q: The officer _____ her on what to expect during the mission.
explain: brief v. 向……简要介绍。
translation: 警官向她简要介绍了任务中可能遇到的情况。

q: Police are trying to _____ the owner of the car parked near the scene.
explain: trace v. 追踪，追溯。
translation: 警方正在努力追查停在现场附近汽车的车主。

q: The police found no _____ of the missing woman in the area.
explain: trace n. 痕迹，踪迹。
translation: 警方在该地区没有发现失踪女子的任何踪迹。

q: We continued _____ the plane on our radar for several hours.
explain: track v. 跟踪，追踪。
translation: 我们在雷达上持续跟踪那架飞机好几个小时。

q: We set off once more over a rough mountain _____.
explain: track n. 小路，轨道。
translation: 我们再次出发，走上了一条崎岖的山间小路。

q: This _____ region is very difficult to travel through in winter.
explain: mountainous adj. 多山的。
translation: 这个多山地区在冬天很难通行。

q: This decision _____ the way for changes in employment rights for women.
explain: pave v. 铺（路）（pave the way 为……铺平道路）。
translation: 这一决定为女性就业权利的变化铺平了道路。

q: _____ his age, he did the job quite well.
explain: given prep. 考虑到。
translation: 考虑到他的年龄，他做得相当好。

q: You have to finish the work within the _____ time.
explain: given adj. 特定的，规定的。
translation: 你必须在规定时间内完成这项工作。

q: She deserves _____ for all the hard work she has done.
explain: credit n. 赞扬，功劳。
translation: 她所做的所有努力值得赞扬。

q: The company is _____ with inventing the first industrial robot.
explain: credit v. 把……归功于（be credited with 被认为……）。
translation: 这家公司被认为发明了第一台工业机器人。

q: He used to be a video game _____ who spent all his free time playing.
explain: addict n. 上瘾的人，成瘾者。
translation: 他曾经是一个游戏成瘾者，把所有空闲时间都花在打游戏上。

q: A _____ of flowers hung on the wall in the living room.
explain: picture n. 图画，照片。
translation: 客厅的墙上挂着一幅花卉图画。

q: I can still _____ the house I grew up in.
explain: picture v. 想象，设想。
translation: 我仍然能想象出我长大的那栋房子。

q: He _____ the hole in the pipe with an old piece of cloth.
explain: plug v. 堵住，塞住。
translation: 他用一块旧布堵住了管道上的洞。

q: I'll have to change the _____ on my hairdryer before I can use it.
explain: plug n. 插头；塞子。
translation: 我得先换掉吹风机上的插头才能使用它。

q: The equipment can be _____ to install if you don't read the instructions.
explain: tricky adj. 棘手的，难对付的。
translation: 如果不看说明书，这台设备可能很难安装。

q: Politicians are ultimately _____ to the voters who elected them.
explain: accountable adj. 负有责任的。
translation: 政客最终要对选举他们的选民负责。

q: Patience is not one of her _____, I'm afraid.
explain: virtue n. 美德；优点。
translation: 恐怕耐心不是她的优点之一。

q: They had dinner at an _____ restaurant in the city center.
explain: upscale adj. 高档的，高消费的。
translation: 他们在市中心一家高档餐厅吃了晚餐。

q: She loves collecting _____ from different countries around the world.
explain: antique n. 古董，古物。
translation: 她喜欢收集来自世界各地的古董。

q: The _____ table went to the lady in the pink hat.
explain: antique adj. 古董的，古老的。
translation: 那张古董桌子卖给了那位戴粉色帽子的女士。

q: It was very _____ of him to wait for us so long.
explain: considerate adj. 体贴的，考虑周到的。
translation: 他等了我们这么久，真是非常体贴。

q: The two countries are in _____ over the boundaries of their coastal waters.
explain: dispute n. 争论，争端（in dispute over 在……上存在争端）。
translation: 两国在领海边界问题上存在争端。

q: No one can _____ the fact that men still hold most public offices.
explain: dispute v. 质疑，对……提出异议。
translation: 没有人能够质疑男性仍然占据大多数公职这一事实。

q: The report _____ bare the shocking housing conditions in this city.
explain: lay v. 放置（lay bare 揭露，暴露）。
translation: 这份报告揭露了这座城市令人震惊的住房条件。

q: Her drama teacher is confident that Julie is a star in the _____.
explain: make v. 做，制造（in the making 在形成中、在酝酿中）。
translation: 她的戏剧老师确信朱莉是一颗正在升起的新星。

q: The rebels were forced to _____ in after weeks of fighting.
explain: give v. 给（give in 屈服，让步）。
translation: 叛军在经过数周战斗后被迫投降。

q: Police have not _____ out the possibility that the man was murdered.
explain: rule v. 统治，裁定（rule out 排除）。
translation: 警方尚未排除这名男子被谋杀的可能性。

q: I think the _____ thing would be to take a taxi home.
explain: sensible adj. 明智的，合理的。
translation: 我认为明智的做法是打车回家。

q: I still have _____ feelings about going to Brazil next year.
explain: mixed adj. 混合的；好坏参半的。
translation: 我对明年去巴西仍然有复杂的感受。

q: These _____ issues must be addressed before we can move forward.
explain: unresolved adj. 未解决的。
translation: 在我们继续推进之前，这些未解决的问题必须得到处理。

q: She beat the other runners by a _____ of ten seconds.
explain: margin n. 差额，幅度。
translation: 她以十秒的优势击败了其他赛跑选手。

q: The story will only be of _____ interest to our readers.
explain: marginal adj. 微小的，不重要的。
translation: 这个故事对我们的读者来说只有很小的吸引力。

q: The vehicle is _____ enough to withstand rough terrain.
explain: sturdy adj. 结实的，坚固的。
translation: 这辆车足够结实，能够承受崎岖的地形。

q: She _____ everything for her children's education and future.
explain: sacrifice v. 牺牲，舍弃。
translation: 她为了孩子们的教育和未来牺牲了一切。

q: Her parents made many _____ so that she could have a good education.
explain: sacrifice n. 牺牲，献出。
translation: 她的父母为了让她接受良好的教育做出了许多牺牲。

q: Upstairs he has a _____ where he paints a little every day.
explain: studio n. 工作室，演播室。
translation: 他在楼上有一间工作室，每天在那里画一点画。

q: He put a _____ into the machine and waited for the ticket.
explain: coin n. 硬币。
translation: 他把一枚硬币放进机器，等待车票。

q: He was the first to _____ the phrase “Make Love, Not War”.
explain: coin v. 创造（新词或短语）。
translation: 他是第一个创造“要做爱，不作战”这个说法的人。

q: In this matter, her opinion is the only one that _____.
explain: count v. 重要，有价值。
translation: 在这件事上，她的意见是唯一重要的。

q: The final _____ showed that more than half the students had voted.
explain: count n. 计数，总数。
translation: 最终计数显示超过一半的学生投了票。

q: Although the news was too much to take in, she decided to _____ the moment.
explain: reframe v. 换个角度重新表达。
translation: 尽管这个消息让人难以接受，她还是决定换个角度来看待这件事。

q: She put the photograph in a wooden _____ and hung it on the wall.
explain: frame n. 框架，边框。
translation: 她把照片放进一个木框里，挂在墙上。

q: You will have to be careful how you _____ the question.
explain: frame v. 表达，措辞。
translation: 你必须注意如何措辞这个问题。

q: You should find better ways to _____ your time.
explain: employ v. 使用，利用。
translation: 你应该找到更好的方式来利用你的时间。

q: He was in the _____ of a large company for over twenty years.
explain: employ n. 雇用，受雇（in the employ of 受雇于）。
translation: 他受雇于一家大公司二十多年。

q: You need to _____ your energies into more useful activities.
explain: redirect v. 改变（资金、精力等的）用途。
translation: 你需要把你的精力投入到更有用的活动中去。

q: The website uses a _____ to send users to the new page.
explain: redirect n. 重定向。
translation: 该网站使用重定向把用户发送到新页面。

q: The role of the person leading the talk is to _____ discussion by asking good questions.
explain: facilitate v. 促进，使便利。
translation: 主持讨论的人的作用是通过提出好的问题来促进讨论。

q: Could you do me a _____ and carry this box upstairs?
explain: favor n. 恩惠，帮忙（do sb. a favor 帮某人一个忙）。
translation: 你能帮我个忙，把这个箱子搬上楼吗？

q: Her father _____ the idea of her going to law school.
explain: favor v. 赞成，支持。
translation: 她的父亲赞成她去上法学院的想法。

q: His _____ was rewarded after many people said no, and he finally found a job.
explain: perseverance n. 坚持不懈，毅力。
translation: 他的坚持不懈得到了回报，在很多人拒绝他之后，他终于找到了一份工作。

q: His life had already been through one great _____ before he moved abroad.
explain: transformation n. 转变，变革。
translation: 在他移居国外之前，他的生活已经经历过一次巨大的转变。

q: None of the passengers and _____ were injured in the accident.
explain: crew n. 全体船员，全体机组人员。
translation: 事故中没有任何乘客和机组人员受伤。

q: I _____ for him on his yacht last summer.
explain: crew v. 在（船上）当船员，为……充当船员。
translation: 去年夏天我在他的游艇上为他当了船员。

q: The guard _____ us up to the gate and let us through.
explain: wave v. 挥手（wave up 挥手示意……上前）。
translation: 警卫挥手示意我们到门口，然后放我们过去了。

q: They are trying to decide where to _____ the new hospital.
explain: situate v. 使坐落于，使位于。
translation: 他们正在努力决定把新医院建在哪里。

q: Allied troops _____ over 300 enemy soldiers during the battle.
explain: capture v. 俘获，捕获。
translation: 盟军部队在战斗中俘获了300多名敌兵。

q: Because of injury, her playing career came to a _____ end in 2008.
explain: premature adj. 过早的，提前的。
translation: 由于受伤，她的运动生涯在2008年提前结束了。

q: The child was born _____ and needed special medical care.
explain: prematurely adv. 过早地，提前地。
translation: 这个孩子早产了，需要特殊的医疗护理。

q: Let's go out for some fresh _____ after sitting inside all day.
explain: air n. 空气。
translation: 在屋里坐了一整天之后，我们出去呼吸点新鲜空气吧。

q: The weekly meeting enables employees to _____ their grievances freely.
explain: air v. 公开发表（意见等）。
translation: 每周的例会让员工能够自由地表达他们的不满。

q: The department has successfully _____ new ideas into the traditional course structure.
explain: integrate v. 使合并，使成为一体。
translation: 该系已成功将新理念融入了传统的课程结构中。

q: Her strange behavior _____ our suspicions about what she was hiding.
explain: arouse v. 引起，激起（情感、态度等）。
translation: 她古怪的行为引起了我们对她隐瞒之事的怀疑。

q: My doctor _____ me to a specialist for further tests.
explain: refer v. 把……送往（某人处）以求帮助或建议。
translation: 我的医生把我转诊给一位专科医生做进一步检查。

q: In his speech, he _____ to a recent trip to Canada.
explain: refer v. 提到，谈及（refer to）。
translation: 在演讲中，他提到了最近去加拿大的一次旅行。
